notes.title: New update
notes.notes: Hello Conservationists, I have removed all the houses on the map so it doesn’t feel so dead but the farms and barns are still there.  The vendors have been moved to one central location.  Across the street from Boss’s Rock Shop.  Made FPS improvements that I hope will help.  Please let me know if you have any further issues with it.

notes.title: New update new stuff
notes.notes:
Hey all ok so I have pushed a new update this update will fix the bug with the fur not changing as well it will add in the field guide for the age of the deer. There will be more to come with that guide but for now you have the age of your deer to help u choose the deer to kill. You can press G to bring it up and to close the guide. I made the inventory button so you can change the button yourself in game I tried working out escape but I have escape set in the code to cancel the bind when u are setting key binds so that is going to be more of a hassle to make happen the way I want. I recommend setting the key to TAB instead of I and change the lock on target to caps lock it don't really work right now and not sure if I will remove it yet so thats Y it is still there. So there is also a new music player so enjoy that you can bring it up by pressing P and close it with same button so now you can play music from any place u want if that's something you want. I also adding in new warm weather camo this camo is great for when you are hunting in warm weather. The full set ups your hunting skill and your stealth skills to 6+ so its worth buying at the shop. There is a camp for saving now as well as a bed in the house to manage saves. Be sure to go home and delete your save if u have one its very important. I hate to do that to yall but with the save system it just has to be that way sorry. I have a Ghost and a rouge bear on the map its not on the starting island. The bear is on the left side of the big island some place close to the park and the fields. Good luck finding it post a pic in discord when you find them I would like to know who has found it. The ghost gives treats so be on the look out for him there will be a few Halloween characters hidden around the map all threw Oct hope yall find and enjoy them they will all give u treats. They will lead us up to the Halloween event that will start the last week of Oct.

notes.title: Lead Developer Here
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I see some new conservationists joining the steam and I wanted to say ‘Hi’ to all of you and ‘thank you for play testing’.  I'm really thankful. 

So let me start this off by saying this game is not perfect! There is still a lot to be done. As of right now there is no mission system, I am in the works of having one.  There is a lot more going on than you think here though.  We have  a full living ecosystem here.  The animals will breed and live just like real animals (of course there is a little game magic that has to happen lol). Now you can raise deer! At the current time you get them from the vendor. There are 5 vendors on the map right now. Look around towns and houses for boxes and lots of things to loot. The vendors will sell you everything that is in the game, although they don't always have everything in stock, but will restock regularly. As you are walking around (Dont run you will spook everything) currently you will see deer, rabbits and coyotes (Many more to come).  I want to test what I have to make sure they are all working well,  adding too many animals at once makes it hard to test.  Plus as the game moves forward, I wont be adding the animals the conservationist (You) will. I have big plans for this!  So you all know right now I am working on trying to figure out how to get foliage that you can harvest in the game. I have had a lot of trouble with it and it’s a hurdle but I will figure it out.  If anyone is having any issues with anything please let me know. I will check steam daily.  I know we have been kind of quiet, just have been super busy but I am here and will talk to ya and answer any questions you may have the best I can.  Thank you

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Hello Conservationists..  First of all Thank You Thank You Thank You for your patience on this update..  As you open this update you will notice many many new changes and areas to explore and hunt.  I hope you will also notice an FPS increase..  The map has been my arch nemesis for quite some time BUT I think I got it.  I do ask that If you fall through the map after a save, please take note of the location and let me know.  That has been a major fight for me and if it is still not fixed then I will keep fighting.  Also we now have lootables in the game.. So if this is one of your favorite parts of a survival game.. go at it!  The harvestable foliage is still being worked on so stay tuned for that.  As always thank you for playing and your feed back.

One more thing to note if you fall threw after u load game like right at the start load it again in the menu it should put u on the landscape just a bug I noticed and a work around for it.

Also there is a cave that u can do some mining in and make some money to buy things. There is also 4 vendors around on the Island you start on

notes.title: Patch to fix issues
notes.notes: Hello Conservationists,  here is another update for you.  I have added some new gear.. You can now go to the vendor and buy yourself some rain gear and snow gear.  The camo  now has added stealth and hunting skills..  Each piece will add to it so get the whole set at once or a little at a time.  I adjusted the weather.  The cold no longer makes you hungry or thirsty but will affect stamina and fatigue.  Hot weather will affect hydration.  The axe and pick axe Should not break so easily.  Also added a tanning rack to dry hides so you can get more money from vendors.  Last but not least added a radio in the cabin so you can enjoy some hunting songs as you warm by the fire.

notes.title: Save Patch
notes.notes: Hello Conservationists!   I DID IT!  All Inventory SAVES!!!  So you can now save your game with inventory and chests full.  So Play-Save-Load-Play again

notes.title: New update new stuff
notes.notes: Hello all Conservationist,  Here is another update.  The last update I may have missed a few crucial pieces in the cabin.  That was my bad, I was testing a few things before I pushed the update.  This update there are a few things in the cabin for  you.  So first note the save system.  I am currently working hard on this as it is crucial for the game and I know it.  As of right now only the animals and placeable items are saving.  I adjusted how loud you are when you are crouched and walking so the deer won't hear you as easily.  I have added mushrooms and berries.  Some you can eat and some you can not.  These are still being worked on so what is safe now might not be safe later, so try one and see what it does to you. But I have a poison kit with you just in case.  I have also hidden a spot in the world but you will need to stop by the vendor for a pickax before looking for it.  There is a surprise in this location. Can you find it?

notes.title: Hello Conservationist
notes.notes: Hello Conservationist we have been busy and now we are bringing a new update. There is a lot that has been added first off lets start with the save system. We are still having trouble with the inventory saving but we have gotten the placeables to save and the animals are saving we will keep working on the save for the inventory. We have added in some resource collecting around the map so be sure to keep a eye out for stuff to eat while you are walking around out there. There is a secret spot added in its not done yet so keep in mind we might not have everything in for it yet but its there and u can check it out now if u can find it. So good luck and happy hunting

notes.title: New Stuff
notes.notes: I know it has been a while, but I have been working hard to get new stuff added and get a good working build for Wilderness Survival.  I'm very excited to say that I will have something to show y'all soon.  You may have noticed, but one important factor is that we changed up the look of our UI and inventory system.  In some of our player/tester feedback, we learned that many players didn't enjoy the jigsaw inventory system, well WE HEAR YOU and have changed it altogether.  Farewell jigsaw, it's time for something new and fresh.  I am currently testing the map to make sure all is good, and everything is working as I expect it to.  Stay tuned for further updates, and I hope everyone is as excited as I am. -Ghost
